profile.account.displayName: Label of the account's sign-in name, read from Discord.
profile.account.email: Label of the account's email address.
profile.account.parrygg: Label of the linked Parry.gg account. Parry.gg is a tournament platform's name.
profile.account.parrygg.linked: Value of the Parry.gg account fact, linking to that profile: it was linked when the player was claimed through Parry.gg.
profile.browsePlayers: Link to the player directory, where a person finds and claims their player.
profile.claim.declined: After a player's name in the list of this account's claim requests: a moderator refused it.
profile.claim.pending: After a player's name in the list of this account's claim requests: a moderator has not decided yet.
profile.deleteAccount.communities: Why the delete button is disabled; {n} is how many communities, {names} their names already joined (A, B and C).
profile.deleteAccount.confirm: Dialog body before an account is deleted, for an account with no player.
profile.deleteAccount.confirm.title: Title of the delete-account confirmation.
profile.deleteAccount.confirm.withPlayer: Dialog body before an account is deleted; {name} is the player that survives it.
profile.deleteAccount.open: Button that opens the delete-account confirmation.
profile.deleteAccount.payments: {names} is a list of events, already joined (A, B and C). Dizzy is the site's name.
profile.deleteAccount.series: {names} is a list of the event series this person runs, already joined (A, B and C).
profile.deleteAccount.siteOwner: Why the delete button is disabled.
profile.deleteAccount.subscription: Why the delete button is disabled; the link opens the Premium section.
profile.deleteAccount.title: Title of the danger-zone row, and the confirm button of its dialog.
profile.display.auto: Setting choice: follow the device or the language.
profile.display.autoWith: Setting choice: follow the device or the language; {value} is what that resolves to now, such as a language name or an example date.
profile.display.clock.example: Help under the Clock setting: the time now written both ways.
profile.display.clock.help: Help under the Clock setting before the current time is known.
profile.display.dateOrder: Setting label: day, month and year order.
profile.display.dateOrder.help: Help under the Date format setting.
profile.display.intro: Opening line of the Display section.
profile.display.language: Setting label: the language the site is shown in.
profile.display.location: Setting label: the town lists are ordered by distance from.
profile.display.sample.event: Preview line: a date and time as an event page writes it.
profile.display.sample.now: Eyebrow over a preview of the current time in the chosen format.
profile.display.sample.recent: Preview line: a relative time, such as 3 minutes ago.
profile.display.sample.table: Preview line: a numeric date as a table writes it.
profile.display.zone.autoDetected: Timezone menu choice: follow the device; {zone} is the zone detected.
profile.display.zone.autoNamed: The timezone button when following the device; {zone} is the zone detected.
profile.host.column.date: Hosted events column: when the event starts.
profile.host.column.event: Hosted events column: the event's name.
profile.host.column.registration: Hosted events column: whether sign-ups are open.
profile.host.column.tournaments: Hosted events column: how many brackets the event has.
profile.host.empty: Hosted events table: this person runs no events.
profile.host.empty.search: Hosted events table: the search found nothing.
profile.host.registration.always: Registration state: open, with no opening or closing date set.
profile.host.registration.always.title: Tooltip on the always-open state.
profile.host.registration.imported: Registration state: the event came from another platform.
profile.host.registration.imported.title: Tooltip on the Imported state.
profile.host.registration.later: Registration state: the window has not started.
profile.host.registration.later.title: Tooltip on the Opens later state.
profile.host.search: Placeholder of the hosted events search.
profile.host.sort.alphabetical: Sort choice for the hosted events table.
profile.host.sort.date: Sort choice for the hosted events table.
profile.identity.country: Setting label: where the player is from.
profile.identity.flag: Setting label: the flag shown beside the player's name.
profile.identity.flag.country: Flag choice: wear the chosen country's flag.
profile.identity.handle: Setting label: the address of the player's profile page.
profile.identity.handle.change: Completes a sentence saying Premium is needed for it; the sentence is built around this phrase.
profile.identity.handle.clear: Help under the handle field when it has a value.
profile.identity.handle.random: Help under the handle field when it is empty.
profile.identity.none: Picker choice: no country, or no flag.
profile.identity.prefix: Setting label: a sponsor or team tag before the player's name.
profile.identity.pronouns.placeholder: Placeholder of the free-text pronouns field: examples, not a closed list.
profile.masthead.findPlayer: Button to the player directory, for an account with no claimed player.
profile.masthead.pending: Under the account's name while a claim waits for a moderator; {name} is the player claimed, linked to their page.
profile.masthead.publicProfile: Link from the account page to the claimed player's public page.
profile.masthead.unclaimed: Under the account's name when no player is claimed.
profile.notifications.intro: Opening line of the Notifications section.
profile.notifications.push: Master switch for every push notification, and its accessible name.
profile.orders.column.event: Order history column: the event the order was for.
profile.orders.column.items: Order history column: what was bought.
profile.orders.column.status: Order history column: paid, pending, expired or cancelled.
profile.orders.column.total: Order history column: the amount paid.
profile.orders.refunded: Under an order's status when the whole amount was refunded.
profile.orders.refundedPart: Under an order's status when part of it was refunded; {amount} is the refunded sum with its currency.
profile.orders.status.expired: Order status: checkout was abandoned and timed out.
profile.orders.status.pending: Order status: checkout was started and not finished.
profile.orders.title: Heading of the account's order history: passes bought for events.
profile.parrygg.claimRequested: Success notice after a claim through Parry.gg is filed; {name} is the player claimed, emphasised; {has} is "some" when their Parry.gg gamer tag {tag} is known, and the bracketed clause is then shown.
profile.parrygg.help: Help under the Parry.gg profile field.
profile.parrygg.label: Label of the field for a Parry.gg profile URL. Parry.gg is a tournament platform's name.
profile.parrygg.pending: The claim button while the Parry.gg profile is being looked up.
profile.parrygg.submit: Button: look the player up from the Parry.gg profile link.
profile.payments.another: Row label for connecting a further Stripe account.
profile.payments.connect: Button: go to Stripe to connect an account.
profile.payments.connectFailed: Notice after returning from Stripe without a connected account.
profile.payments.connected: Notice after returning from Stripe with the account connected.
profile.payments.disconnect: Button: remove a connected Stripe account.
profile.payments.disconnecting: The Disconnect button while it runs.
profile.payments.intro: Opening line of the Payments section. Stripe is the payment provider's name.
profile.payments.status.enabled: Connected account state: it can take payments.
profile.payments.status.incomplete: Connected account state: setup at Stripe was not finished.
profile.payments.status.review: Connected account state: details sent, Stripe has not approved it yet.
profile.payments.stripe: Row label for a connected Stripe account, or for connecting the first one. The provider's name.
profile.payments.unavailable: In place of the connect button when payments are switched off.
profile.payments.unconfigured: Help when payments are switched off on this copy of the site.
profile.player.noGames: Player section for a claimed player with no rated games yet. The link opens the Public profile section; keep its text the section's name.
profile.player.unclaimed: Player section for an account that has not claimed a player. "Public profile" is the section's name.
profile.premium.addAvatar: Link to upload an animated avatar, for a subscriber with none yet.
profile.premium.avatar: Premium perk: a moving profile picture.
profile.premium.avatar.help: Help under the Animated avatar perk.
profile.premium.badge: Premium perk: a badge shown on the profile; {name} is the badge's name.
profile.premium.cancelling: Warning under the dates for a subscription that will not renew.
profile.premium.claimFirst: Under the Premium perks for a subscriber who has not yet claimed a player; the link opens the player directory.
profile.premium.comped: Under the standing for an account given Premium free by the site.
profile.premium.cosmetic: Opening line of the Premium section.
profile.premium.dormant: Animated avatar state after Premium lapses: kept, but not shown.
profile.premium.failed: Shown when opening Stripe checkout or the billing portal failed with no message of its own.
profile.premium.frozen: Handle perk state after Premium lapses: the handle is kept and cannot be changed.
profile.premium.handle: Premium perk: a chosen address for the player's profile page.
profile.premium.interval.month: Premium plan name: billed every month.
profile.premium.interval.year: Premium plan name: billed every year.
profile.premium.lapse: Closing line of the Premium section.
profile.premium.locked: Perk state for an account without Premium.
profile.premium.onProfile: Link to the player's profile, where the Premium badge is shown.
profile.premium.period.ended: Label of the date a lapsed subscription stopped.
profile.premium.period.ends: Label of the date Premium stops, for a subscription set to cancel.
profile.premium.period.renews: Label of the date Premium next bills.
profile.premium.plan: Label of the subscriber's billing plan (Monthly, Yearly).
profile.premium.plan.subscription: The plan's value when its billing interval is unknown.
profile.premium.setHandle: Link to the handle field, for a subscriber with no handle yet.
profile.premium.standing: Eyebrow over the subscriber's Premium state (Active, Lapsed, Not subscribed).
profile.premium.standing.active: Premium state: live, by subscription or granted.
profile.premium.standing.lapsed: Premium state: subscribed once, not live now.
profile.premium.subscribe: Button: start a monthly subscription; {price} is the price per month, already formatted.
profile.premium.subscribeYearly: Button: start a yearly subscription; {price} is the price per year, already formatted.
profile.premium.unclaimed: Perk state when the account has no claimed player to show it on.
profile.public.unclaimed: Public profile section, for an account that has not claimed a player.
profile.saved: Confirmation beside the save button once the changes are stored.
profile.section.account: Rail entry and section heading: sign-in facts, order history and account deletion.
profile.section.developer: Rail entry and section heading: the person's API keys.
profile.section.display: Rail entry and section heading: language, location, timezone, date format and clock.
profile.section.host: Rail entry and section heading: the events this person organises.
profile.section.notifications: Rail entry and section heading: push notification preferences.
profile.section.payments: Rail entry and section heading: the Stripe accounts a host takes payments through.
profile.section.player: Rail entry and section heading: the claimed player's per-game settings (characters).
profile.section.premium: Rail entry and section heading: the paid subscription. Premium is the product's name.
profile.section.profile: Rail entry and section heading: the settings everyone else sees (handle, prefix, pronouns, country, flag, avatar).
profile.title: The account settings page's title: the browser tab, the rail's heading and the masthead's eyebrow when no player is claimed.
profile.under18.born: Asked after someone answers Yes to 'Are you under 18?'. Two fields follow: a month and a year. Only the month and year are asked for, never the day.
profile.under18.bornChange: Shown in place of the birth-month question when an answer is already saved and the person has pressed Yes again. Two fields follow: a month and a year.
profile.under18.month: Label of the field for the month someone was born in.
profile.under18.month.placeholder: Grey text in the empty birth-month field.
profile.under18.question: The question itself, answered with Yes or No. Read by children as well as adults, so keep it as short and plain as the English.
profile.under18.status.adult: Shown after someone answers Yes but gives a birth month that makes them 18 already.
profile.under18.status.flagged: Shown to a player who was marked as under 18 by someone else: an event host, or a site moderator. Their own answer does not remove that mark.
profile.under18.status.until: What is saved about someone who said they are under 18. {month} is a month and a year already written in the reader's language, for example 'June 2030'.
profile.under18.title: Heading over the under-18 question in a person's account settings, and the name of the same question where it is asked on the home page.
profile.under18.why: Under the birth month and year fields. It tells a child what is kept before they answer, so use short sentences and no legal words.
profile.under18.year: Label of the field for the year someone was born in.
profile.under18.year.placeholder: Grey text in the empty birth-year field.
profile.you: Stands in for the account's name in the masthead when Discord supplied none.
